title: The Submerged Peak
subtitle: A Youthful Intruder Sparks a Hidden Mystery
summary: When the brash and precocious Nengti Dutta bursts into Byomkesh Bakshi’s life, he brings with him more than just clever conversation—he awakens the detective’s curiosity with hints of a secret lurking beneath the surface. As past and present collide in post-independence India, Byomkesh finds himself drawn into an affair that challenges his wit and reveals truths long submerged. Dive into a tale where sharp minds and sharper mysteries collide.
